text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/prices.py:19:deprecated-method"], "search": "    return pl.json()", "replace": "    return pl.model_dump_json()", "explanation": "BaseModel.json() is deprecated in Pydantic v2 in favor of model_dump_json(), which is the v2 API for serializing a model to a JSON string. pl is a PriceList, a Pydantic BaseModel."}], "notes": "One edit addresses the single finding. No import changes are needed because the file only uses BaseModel, and model_dump_json is a method on it. Behavior caveat: v1 .json() encoded Decimal as a JSON number through pydantic_encoder, while v2 model_dump_json() encodes Decimal as a JSON string by default, so the output text for price and discount will change from numbers to quoted strings. The finding asks for this replacement, so I kept it. If the consumers need numeric output, that would need a field serializer or a separate decision, which I did not add. No documentation was retrieved, so the rationale rests on the standard v2 API mapping."}
